hypothesis: The pinned full circle-taxi evaluator can complete a known baseline candidate within the local wall budget when its existing streaming node-potential computation uses eight bounded worker processes and no large circle B cache is allocated.
rationale: The shared-cache experiment proved that a single 1.12GB circle cache is stable but did not finish taxi evaluation with one nested worker. The pinned evaluator's batch_compute_potential_mp computes node potentials in chunks and does not require the circle B cache, so bounded parallelism may reduce the dominant full-taxi runtime without repeating the failed fast-worker architecture.
expected_information_gain: Measures whether the exact primary taxi contract is practically executable with bounded streaming parallelism and verifies the result against the already reproduced 17-violation human baseline before any search allocation.
method: Load the exact pinned search source and adapter at the locked upstream commit. Call its unmodified evaluate_heavy_candidate stage-D path on the first pinned SEED_VECTORS candidate, using the pinned circle_taxi_k4_m6 metric, the fixed n=7 matrix, and batch_compute_potential_mp with exactly eight nested processes. Do not build the circle cache, alter the evaluator, alter metric data, or search coefficient space. Preserve the complete payload and timings.
metric: exact pinned circle_taxi_k4_m6 violations_k for the known baseline candidate
metric_relation_to_true_objective: A result of 17 reproduces the known human baseline and is capability evidence only; a result below 3 would be a target-relevant finite metric result, but this experiment does not search and cannot by itself establish a novel candidate.

configuration.cache_architecture: streaming node potentials; no circle B cache

compute_budget.cpu: one parent plus eight bounded potential workers
compute_budget.memory_intent: stream node potentials and avoid the 1.12GB-per-worker circle cache

kill_condition: Stop at the first completed exact baseline score, at 1200 seconds, or at a precise runtime/metric/contract failure. Do not infer target progress from an interrupted or partial result.

baseline_comparison.expected_relation: completed result should reproduce 17; no improvement is expected from this baseline-only capability test

previous_best_comparison.shared_cache_result: no completed taxi score after 1200 seconds with one nested process
previous_best_comparison.expected_relation: eight-process streaming should either complete the known baseline or establish a stronger local capability boundary

repetition_justification: This is a capability-controlled baseline run, not a coefficient or worker-pool search repeat: it removes the giant circle cache entirely and parallelizes only the pinned streaming taxi potential computation, addressing the specific remaining bottleneck identified by kserver-n7-shared-cache-001.
